newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids higher.

text.p: Bids for dark northern spring wheat were mostly higher Tuesday in line with gains in futures on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange, dealers said.
"We're up a little, just with the futures," a Montana merchandiser said. "There was very little movement."
MGE July wheat futures settled flat at $3.72 cents per bushel and other months were 1-1/2 to 3-1/4 higher.
Some merchandisers reported sales sparked by ideas that prices would only move lower from this point.
Recent rains have left many optimistic about prospects for the new crop, merchandisers said.
"We've had broad-based rains up here which is good for the crop," a Minnesota dealer said. "There aren't too many places up here that haven't received an inch of rain this week."
Bids for white wheat were also lower, merchandisers said.
"Nothing's trading," said an Oregon dealer. "They (farmers) don't like these prices."
